meta.defaultTitle: Ethos — Digital gifts that open like a story
meta.description: Create a personalised, animated digital gift for someone you love. Photos, their song, your words. Share with a link or QR code. Free to start.

hero.eyebrow: Digital gifts. Ten minutes to make, years to keep.
hero.sub: A personal, animated gift page with your photos, their song and your words. Sent as a link or a QR code, opened on their phone.
hero.videoAlt: The Bouquet template: flowers come together one by one, the paper folds round and a card drops in.
hero.caption: Bouquet, our newest template. The real thing, not a mockup.
hero.ctaNote: Free to start. No account until you publish.

templates.title: Every template is a whole experience.
templates.blurb: Not a card with a photo slot. Each one is a scene the recipient moves through: tapping, scrolling, holding, sometimes blowing out candles.
templates.moreBlurb: New templates land regularly. Everything buyers get every future one, forever.

reactions.title: The link goes out. The reply comes back.
reactions.blurb: At the end of every gift there is a reaction button: an emoji, a note, or a 20-second voice message, delivered straight to you.

cards.sent: I made you something. Open it with sound on.
cards.reply: I'm at work and crying in the stairwell. Three years. THREE.

cards.sent: Look up. Well, look at your phone.
cards.reply: You put the tent night in there. I found all six. Fourteen days.

cards.sent: Feliz día, ma. Tap the seal.
cards.reply: Quién te enseñó a hacer esto?? Lo vi cuatro veces ya.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.body: Try any of them full-screen first. Two are free; the rest unlock once and stay yours.

steps.title: Add your photos and words
steps.body: Drop in photos, pick their song, write what you'd never say out loud. The preview updates as you type.

steps.title: Share the link, or the card
steps.body: Send it on WhatsApp, iMessage, anywhere. Or print the QR card and hide it in a book.

occasions.title: For the day, or for no reason at all.
occasions.blurb: Templates are tagged by occasion, but nothing stops you sending a birthday sky in March.

final.title: Say the thing.
final.blurb: The people we love mostly hear us in passing. This is the other way: a small, deliberate thing they can open twice.

openings.title: Choose how it opens.
openings.blurb: The first thing they see is a cover with their name on it. Pick the one that feels like them; the gift is waiting underneath.

footer.blurb: Gifts that open like a story.

faq.a: No. Templates, game packs and gift cards are one-time payments, and what you unlock stays on your account for good. Ethos for Two is a pass: one payment for 365 days, for both of you. It never renews on its own; we email you two weeks before it ends, and renewing is one tap.

faq.q: What does the free tier actually include?
faq.a: Two full templates (The Letter and Constellations), unlimited gifts, up to 10 photos per gift, our music library, a 30-second preview of a real song they can tap to hear, a countdown and a hidden final surprise. Free gifts show a small “Made with Ethos” footer. Video clips, voice messages, up to 20 photos, no footer, scheduling and a password come with “Make it special”, a small one-time payment for that template, or with any unlock.

faq.q: Can I try a template before paying?
faq.a: Every template has a full live demo, and the editor is free to use with a live preview. You only pay when you publish something that needs a premium feature.

A year of everything for the two of you: every gift template and every game pack, on both your accounts. One of you pays; the other joins with the invite link you send. It's one payment for 365 days, not a subscription.

Buy “Give Everything” and we email you a code (it's on the confirmation page too). Pass it on however you like: whoever redeems it gets every template, forever, on their own account. A code can be redeemed for two years.
Extra decks for the games: more questions, bolder dares. Each one is a one-time payment and yours for good, and every pack comes with Ethos for Two. The games themselves stay free.
Yes. Whoever receives a gift you paid for can send you one back in the same template, free, with the small “Made with Ethos” footer. If they want extras or no footer on it, they pay the normal price.
No. The price on this page is the price for everyone, and we don't run discount codes. Creators who share Ethos are paid a commission by us through their own link; it never changes what you pay.
No. Links are meant to be permanent. If we ever had to change that we'd give you at least 90 days' notice.

faq.q: Can I edit a gift after it's live?
faq.a: Yes. Edits go live at the same link the moment you save.
Prices are in euros, and Stripe Checkout shows the final amount in your currency before you pay. Card, Apple Pay and other methods, through Stripe. Prices include VAT where it applies.

At checkout you ask us to unlock your purchase straight away and tick that you then lose the 14-day right to cancel. If a gift won't open or play properly on their phone and we can't fix it, tell us within 30 days and you get your money back. Gift cards are different: change your mind within 14 days, before the code is redeemed, and we refund you in full. Where the right to cancel still applies, “Withdraw from a purchase” (at the foot of every page) says how.

where.title: Pick your town

when.title: Pick a day

add.body: Tap + on the places you like. You can change the order later.

plan.body: Once a place is in, “Our plan” appears at the bottom of the screen. Open it and share the link: the whole plan travels inside it, so there's nothing to install.

preview.title: Preview it
preview.body: See exactly what they'll see on their phone, and play it from the start.

publish.body: When it's ready, publish it and you get a private link. They open it on their phone, no app needed.

phones.title: One phone or two
phones.body: Some games pass one phone back and forth on the sofa. Others give you a phone each, even miles apart.

room.title: Playing on two phones
room.body: Open a two-phone game and you get a room. Send the link, or read out the four-letter code, and they're in.

packs.title: Pick a pack
packs.body: Each pack is a new set of cards for a different kind of night.

flights.title: Search flights for two
flights.body: Pick both airports and your dates, and the search opens ready-made on the big flight sites.

trip.title: Open a trip
trip.body: Each one is planned day by day, with the stops, the best months to go and a rough budget.

surprise.title: Make it a surprise
surprise.body: Turn the trip into a gift: a boarding pass they open on their phone, with a packing list of clues.

seo.templatesDescription: {count} animated digital gift templates, from a wax-sealed love letter to a bouquet that never wilts. Add your photos, a song and your words. Every one has a free live demo.
seo.occasionsDescription: Personal, animated digital gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, long-distance love, apologies and more. Photos, their song and your words, sent as a link or QR code.

birthday.title: Digital birthday gifts
birthday.description: Make a digital birthday gift they'll open again and again: your photos, their favourite song and your words, animated and sent as a link or QR code. Free to start.
birthday.intro: A birthday message that does more than sit in a chat. Blow out the candles in Birthday Cinema, crack open a Fortune Cookie or print a Front Page about them, with your photos and their song, and set it to open at midnight.

anniversary.title: Digital anniversary gifts
anniversary.description: An anniversary gift made from your own story: your photos, your song and a letter in your words, animated and sent as a link. Try every template free.
anniversary.intro: One year or twenty: tell the story of the two of you with the photos only you have, the song that's yours and a note that says what a card can't. Walk them down Our Timeline, hang your photos in a Museum or seal it all in The Letter.

valentines.title: Digital Valentine's Day gifts
valentines.description: A Valentine's gift that arrives in seconds and lasts for years: a wax-sealed love letter, a bouquet that never wilts or a sky full of your photos, with your song.
valentines.intro: Flowers wilt and chocolates don't last the evening. A love letter they open with a tap, a bouquet you picked stem by stem, or a night sky where every photo is a star will still be there next February.

wedding.title: Digital wedding gifts
wedding.description: A wedding gift for the couple or for each other: photos, your wishes and a song gathered in an animated gift to keep, shared with a link or a printed QR card.
wedding.intro: Collect the moments and the words that matter into something the couple can open the morning after, or give one to your partner before the ceremony. Print the QR card and tuck it inside a real one.

graduation.title: Digital graduation gifts
graduation.description: Celebrate a graduate with a digital gift: photos from every year, a message from you and a song that fits, sent as a link to open on the big day.
graduation.intro: From the first day to the cap and gown. Line up the photos, say what you're proud of, and time it to open the day they finish. Front Page puts them on the cover; Our Timeline draws the road that got them there.

christmas.title: Digital Christmas gifts
christmas.description: A Christmas gift that can't get lost in the post: an animated gift with your photos, a festive song and your message, timed to open on Christmas morning.
christmas.intro: For the people you won't see this year, and the ones you will: a gift that opens on Christmas morning wherever they are, with no shipping deadline to miss. Shake your photos into the snow in Snow Globe, or leave a letter by the fire in Fireside.

mothers-day.title: Digital Mother's Day gifts
mothers-day.description: Tell your mum what she means to you with a digital Mother's Day gift: old photos, her favourite song and a letter in your words, sent as a link she can keep.
mothers-day.intro: Find the old photos, pick the song she always sings along to, and write the things that are hard to say out loud. Give her a Bouquet that never wilts, or a Jar of Reasons to shake one out whenever she likes.

fathers-day.title: Digital Father's Day gifts
fathers-day.description: A Father's Day gift he'll actually keep: photos through the years, a song he loves and a note from you, in an animated gift sent as a link.
fathers-day.intro: Skip another tie. Put the road trips, the lessons and the terrible jokes into a gift that opens on his phone: his own Front Page, or a Museum of the two of you.

apology.title: Digital apology gifts
apology.description: Say sorry properly: a heartfelt apology letter with your photos and a song, sent as a digital gift that shows you took the time. Free to start.
apology.intro: When a text isn't enough. Take the time to write what you mean, add the moments that matter, and send something they can open when they're ready. The Letter is free, and a Text Thread says it one bubble at a time.

long-distance.title: Long-distance relationship gifts
long-distance.description: Gifts for long-distance relationships that arrive the moment you send them: a passport that flies from your city to theirs, a sky of your photos, or a love letter with your song.
long-distance.intro: Miles apart, still close. Send something they can open the second it's ready, scheduled for their time zone, with the places and the songs that belong to you both.

halloween.title: Digital Halloween gifts
halloween.description: A Halloween gift they open with a tap: a doorbell, a jack-o'-lantern, a small ghost with your photos and your words, and a song in the dark. Free to start.
halloween.intro: Better than a bag of sweets. Ring the bell in Trick or Treat, light the pumpkin and let a small ghost hand over your photos, your message and your song.

just-because.title: Just because gifts
just-because.description: No occasion needed: a small digital gift with your photos, a song and a few honest words, to tell someone you're thinking of them.
just-because.intro: The best gifts don't wait for a date on the calendar. Make one in ten minutes and send it for no reason at all.

notes.london: Most of London's big museums are free, so the museum date costs only the glass of something after. And with the West End so close, a night at the theatre is an easy yes.
notes.manchester: The centre is compact, so dinner, a film and a late dessert rarely need more than a walk between them.
notes.edinburgh: Calton Hill is a short walk from Princes Street and costs nothing, which makes getting up for the sunrise an easy sell.
notes.dublin: The National Gallery and the National Museum are free to walk into, which is exactly what a wet afternoon needs.
notes.new-york: Pick two stops in the same neighbourhood and walk between them: in New York, the streets are half the date.
notes.los-angeles: Distances are long here, so choose one neighbourhood and keep the date in it. The beach at sunset is worth the drive.
notes.chicago: The lakefront has sandy beaches a short ride from the Loop, so the beach date is closer than you'd think.
notes.san-francisco: Most neighbourhoods have a hilltop park within a steep walk, and they are the best seats in town for the golden hour.
notes.miami: Midday heat is serious for much of the year, so the ideas for early mornings and evenings come first.
notes.boston: The centre is small and walkable, and the Public Garden, with its lagoon, sits right in the middle of it.
notes.toronto: The islands are a short ferry ride from downtown, with beaches, paths and a view of the skyline back.
notes.vancouver: Stanley Park and the seawall start at the edge of downtown, so an outdoor date needs no car.
notes.montreal: Winters are long and cold, so ice rinks and hot chocolate aren't a novelty here: they're the season. For the view, walk up Mount Royal.
notes.sydney: The beaches, the harbour and its ferries are all part of the city, so the ideas by the water come first.
notes.melbourne: Laneways, galleries and kitchens that stay open late: this is a city for an evening that runs longer than planned.
notes.auckland: The weather can change in an afternoon here, so keep an indoor idea in your pocket for when it turns.
notes.paris: A picnic by the river is a local habit, and some of the big museums stay open late one evening a week.
notes.amsterdam: It rains a fair bit, and the city is full of small galleries and big museums for exactly those days.
notes.berlin: Late nights are normal here, so the evening ideas can start later than you'd plan anywhere else.
notes.munich: The English Garden, one of the largest city parks anywhere, is a short walk from the centre.
notes.vienna: The coffee houses are made for staying: nobody will hurry you away from a table for two.
notes.prague: The old centre is at its quietest early in the morning, which is when the bridges belong to the two of you.
notes.copenhagen: Hiring a small boat for the canals and the harbour is a summer habit here, and nobody expects you to know how to sail.
notes.stockholm: The city is built on islands, so walking between two stops usually means walking along the water.
notes.oslo: The fjord starts at the edge of the centre, and the opera house roof is free to walk up for the view.
notes.lisbon: The miradouros, the city's lookout terraces, are free and made for the golden hour.
notes.rome: Gelato and a slow walk through the centre: a date the city has had a long time to perfect.
notes.riga: The Old Town is small enough to cross in a quarter of an hour, and the canal parks run right alongside it.
notes.tallinn: The Old Town has viewing platforms over its rooftops, a short climb from the main square.
notes.singapore: The heat is steady and afternoon downpours are common, so indoor and evening ideas sit near the top: eat late, then walk once the air cools.
notes.dubai: For much of the year it's too hot to be out at midday, so evenings and indoor ideas come first, an ice rink included. For the stars, head to the desert.

how.title: You post. They come through your link. We pay you.

apply.title: Apply and get your link
apply.body: Send us an email. Once you're in, you get a personal link of your own, like {link}: put it in your bio or your caption.

post.title: Post what you make
post.body: Show a gift you made, a date you found on the map or a game you played together, and point people to the link in your bio.

checkout.title: They buy through your link
checkout.body: When someone who came through your link buys, the sale is yours: {commission}% of what they pay, not counting VAT. They pay the normal price. There's no code to type and no discount.

paid.title: Get paid every month
paid.body: Early each month we pay what you earned the month before, by bank transfer or PayPal, once it's over €{min}. Until then, it carries over to the next month.

count.title: Your link is the whole count. No cookies, no codes.
count.link: A sale is yours when the buyer arrived through your link and paid in that same visit. That's all we look at: not a code typed at checkout, and not a cookie that runs out after 30 days.
count.browsers: Nothing is stored on their phone, so it works in TikTok's and Instagram's in-app browsers and nobody has to accept a cookie banner for you to get paid.
count.forget: The flip side: if someone closes the page and comes back another way later, we can't tell the sale was yours. Keep the link easy to find.
count.own: Your own purchases don't count, even through your own link: the commission is for people you bring.
count.base: Your {commission}% is worked out on what the buyer paid, not counting VAT. If a sale is refunded or disputed, its commission goes with it.

rules.title: Four rules, and the first one is the law.

disclose.title: Say it's an ad
disclose.body: On TikTok, turn on the content disclosure setting so the video carries the “Paid partnership” label, and put #ad in the caption. On Instagram, use the paid partnership label. The EU, the UK and the US all require it, and a link in your bio on its own doesn't count as saying so.

honest.title: Only real reactions
honest.body: Show gifts you really made and reactions that really happened. No fake reviews, no made-up testimonials, and no pretending you're not being paid.

spam.title: No spam
spam.body: Don't drop your link in other people's comments, send it to strangers in DMs or post it on coupon sites. Share it with the people who follow you.

adult.title: 18 or over
adult.body: You need to be 18 or over to join, and able to receive payments in your own name.

rules.close: If a rule is broken, we may close your link.

link.invalidBody: It may be incomplete, or what it pointed to is already gone.
link.unavailableBody: Try the link again in a few minutes.
